# Socratink

> Make the thinking your own.

Pick something you wish you could explain to a friend. Talk it through with an AI tutor. Your skill map shows what you can do with help and what you can do on your own.

## Work through an idea

Bring a question about something you want to understand. The tutor breaks the topic into skills and suggests where to start. Type or dictate what you think. The tutor might ask you to predict what happens next, explain why, or apply the idea to a new case.

You can ask for a hint, a worked example, or a direct answer. If you choose Hint on a question card, Socratink saves that request with the question.

## Read your skill map

Each level reflects the tutor’s judgment of your work on one skill in this conversation.

| Level | What it means |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | The skill is new to you. |
| 1 | You have heard of it. |
| 2 | You can follow an explanation. |
| 3 | You can do it with help. |
| 4 | You can do it on your own. |
| 5 | You can teach it or handle unusual cases. |

Ask to see your skill map during the conversation. Choose a skill to practice next.

## Pick up where you left off

You can start as a guest. Open History in the app menu to return to a conversation from that guest session. When you sign in, you can open your account’s conversations on another device.
